task_title: Render worktree-server canvas loopback links as localhost

rounds.notes: Reviewed the formatLinkHost change (loopback/wildcard binds -> 'localhost'). One theoretical edge case raised (a port bound on both loopback families could have Happy Eyeballs probe the other family) and dismissed with rationale: implausible for a dev-server helper and would affect only best-effort route availability, nothing durable. Non-loopback IPv4 pass-through and non-loopback IPv6 bracketing verified unchanged. No code changes required.
